Symptom you see: RuntimeError: features were extracted with a newer version of stamp, please update to at least 2.5.0
Cause: Features extracted with STAMP 2.5.0; the training image ran STAMP 2.4.0
Fix: Image now reads features extracted by STAMP up to 2.5.0. No re-extraction needed

Symptom you see: docker: invalid reference format: repository name (library/ID) must be lowercase
Cause: A STAMP_* value contains a space (e.g. an ID column named 'Slide ID') and the arg got split
Fix: Kit forwards STAMP_* by name so values with spaces survive

Symptom you see: KeyError: 'STAMP_CLINI_TABLE' although echo shows it is set
Cause: Ran via sudo, or ran 'bash setup.sh' — both reset/lose the environment, so STAMP_* never reach the container
Fix: Don't use sudo (add yourself to the docker group) and 'source setup.sh' not 'bash setup.sh'. The kit now detects the sudo case and says so

Cause: Patients have several slides but no slide table; the loader expected one H5 per patient
Fix: Provide slide_table.csv and set STAMP_SLIDE_TABLE + STAMP_FILENAME_LABEL

Cause: Local training used the preflight's 1-epoch default instead of STAMP_MAX_EPOCHS
Fix: Local training now runs STAMP_MAX_EPOCHS (32). Re-run your baseline on the ACTIVE kit

Symptom you see: Warning: Found N module(s) in eval mode at the start of training
Cause: The prediction/validation path left the model in eval mode; from epoch 2 on it trained with dropout disabled
Fix: Model is put back into train mode before each fit

Symptom you see: Unknown parameter passed: device=0 (with --GPU device=0, which is valid)
Cause: An empty $SCRATCHDIR expanded to nothing so --scratch_dir swallowed --GPU
Fix: Set/export SCRATCHDIR; the kit now says 'Option --scratch_dir requires a value'. Check with: echo [$SCRATCHDIR]

Symptom you see: SSH OK — live sync enabled, then every rsync fails with 'Another instance of rrsync is already accessing this directory'
Cause: The upload guard locked the whole upload root; one site's live-sync blocked all others
Fix: Guard now uses rrsync -no-lock; each site writes its own subdirectory
